result.title: PDE-PFN: Prior-Data Fitted Neural PDE Solver
result.summary: Motivated by the success of large language models (LLMs) with broad generalizability and robustness to noisy or unreliable pre-training data, we explore in-context prediction of PDE solution fields using approximate pre-training data. In addition, inspired by the posterior predictive mean-based inference mechanism of the in-context learning in prior-data fitted networks (PFNs), we propose PDE-PFN, a prior-data fitted neural solver that approximates the posterior predictive mean of PDE solutions via in-context learning. PDE-PFN builds on a PFN architecture with self- and cross-attention mechanisms of Transformer and is pre-trained on noisy approximate solutions generated by physics-informed neural networks, serving as diverse but not necessarily exact priors. Through experiments on a range of two-dimensional PDEs, we demonstrate that PDE-PFN achieves empirical generalization across heterogeneous equations, robustness under noisy priors, and zero-gradient-update in-context inference capability. PDE-PFN achieves competitive or improved predictive accuracy relative to the evaluated baselines while supporting flexible context and query representations.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 PDE-PFN：以 prior-data fitted network 架构（自注意力＋交叉注意力）在 PINN 生成的含噪近似解上预训练，用 in-context learning 近似 PDE 解的后验预测均值，在多种二维 PDE 上实现跨方程泛化与免梯度更新推理。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理主线距离较远，但其「用含噪、不精确先验数据训练仍鲁棒」和「以交叉注意力做免梯度 in-context 适应」的思路，可供核查 LVR 中监督噪声、上下文证据利用与推理期状态更新等问题的类比线索。
